overview: Generate a frozen-input FY2024 research report for Tesla (TSLA) covering executive summary, financial statements or gaps, valuation or limitations, risks, and investment conclusion, with explicit citations and all required output formats.
requirements: Cover executive summary, three statements or gaps, valuation or limitation, risks, and investment conclusion.
Emit explicitly labeled critical claims and body citations.

tasks.description: Gather frozen snapshot evidence for Tesla (TSLA) FY2024: retrieve 10-K filings, financial statements, market snapshot from Yahoo Finance, and relevant news. Output ranked evidence candidates with explicit evidence_ids.
tasks.expected_output: List of evidence records with evidence_id, source, snippet, and relevance score.

tasks.description: Perform financial statement analysis on TSLA FY2024 evidence: compute ratios, build three-statement view (income, balance, cash flow), identify any gaps in reported data. Output tables and claims with evidence_ids.
tasks.expected_output: Financial statement tables and gap analysis with evidence-backed claims.

tasks.description: Perform valuation analysis for TSLA FY2024 using DCF or multiples, note limitations due to frozen snapshot. Output valuation model, sensitivity table, and limitation notes.
tasks.expected_output: Valuation range, key assumptions, and documented limitations.

tasks.description: Identify key risks for TSLA FY2024 based on evidence: regulatory, competition, demand, production, macro risks. Output risk table with likelihood, impact, and evidence references.
tasks.expected_output: Risk assessment matrix with evidence citations.

tasks.description: Assemble final TSLA FY2024 report: executive summary, three statements or gaps, valuation or limitation, risks, and investment conclusion. Include critical claims with body citations, embed charts/tables from task_002/003/004. Output Markdown, HTML, and JSON reports.
tasks.expected_output: Complete report in three formats with inline evidence citations and charts.

tasks.description: Verify the final report: check that all material factual claims have explicit evidence_id citations, numbers are from frozen snapshots, all required sections present, constraints satisfied. Return pass/fail with revision notes.
tasks.expected_output: Verification report: pass/fail and list of issues if any.

data_sources: Frozen snapshot evidence (e.g., Tesla FY2024 10-K filing, Yahoo Finance historical snapshot)
